scope: dpf_files iCloud import and USB photo preparation workflow
sources_relied_upon: Repository configuration, pipeline, and test suite
Configured local iCloud Photos folder and USB output paths
Existing visual-duplicate audit and cleanup reports
material_decisions: The USB rebuild reads the configured iCloud Photos source and overwrites its output by default.
Exact and conservative visual duplicate detection prevent matching images from reaching USB output or being re-imported to iCloud.
iCloud files that stall when read through WSL are deferred after a bounded timeout so the rebuild can continue and retry them on a later run.
iCloud visual cleanup retains the oldest file in a match group and deletes newer files only when explicitly invoked.
open_questions: A separate keyframe-based audit would be needed to detect visually duplicate videos.
recommended_next_step: Run the normal photo preparation command; it rebuilds USB output, records deferred cloud files, and retries them in a future run after iCloud makes them available.
